Photograph of the noticeboard outside the Torvig harbour office. Nothing in the
picture carries meaning the text below does not: it is a board with paper on it,
photographed slightly from the left.

Transcribed, top to bottom:

**FERRY — MAIL BOAT** — Torvig to Ashwind, daily except Sunday, departs 07:40.
Weather permitting. Tickets from the office or on board.

**TIDE** — Today: high water 04:12 and 16:38, low water 10:25 and 22:51. Range
3.1 m.

**WARNING STAGES** — Green: normal. Amber: surge expected above 0.5 m, move
gear off the low quay. Red: surge above 1.2 m, the low quay floods.

**LOST** — One oar, ash, initials K.M. burnt into the loom. Return to the
office, no questions asked.
